main_text.head: QVÆST. 2.

p.i: An quis aliquem licite occidat, si primum illi concesserit, aut permiserit arma?

main_text.p: QUandoque accidit, ut qui se læsum existumat adversario in loco solitario fiat obviam. Cumque eum absque ense reperiat, in hæc forte verba erumpet. Unde tu timide? quære tibiensem, & quantocyus ad me revertere; ego hic subsistam, teque exspecta-bo. Unde quæsitum, an si adversarium revertentem, & gladium stringentem interfecerit, §. 2. in fin.Inst. Adl.A-quil.id jure fecisse dicatur ? Resp. Minime gentium. Et quia non incidit in insidias, adeoque semet legitime tutatus non est, sed irruit in eas; non evitat malum, sed provocat, quod etiam citra omne periculum effugere potuisset, adeoque debuis-

page.notes: The left margin note is printed in small type as "§. 2.in / fin.Inst. / Adl.A- / quil." and is transcribed as one note beside "id jure fecisse". The initial Q is a woodcut letter joined to "UAndoque" as "QUandoque". Long s is rendered as plain s throughout. "tibiensem" and "exspecta-bo" are as printed. No doubtful readings.
